cases.question: In 2012, who had the least consumption in LAM?
cases.evidence: Year 2012 can be presented as Between 201201 And 201212; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.
cases.analysis: All three queries total 2012 consumption by customer, filter LAM, and select the smallest annual total. They add a consumption column to the requested customer ID. Evidence and Gold-only pass; the combined score timed out, so its later raw reply is diagnostic only.

SELECT
  T1.customer_id
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2

WITH czk_2013 AS (
  SELECT
    ym.customer_id,
    c.segment,
    ym.consumption
  FROM yearmonth AS ym
  INNER JOIN customers AS c

),

  SELECT DISTINCT ON (segment)

    annual_avg_consumption
  FROM customer_metrics
  ORDER BY segment, total_consumption ASC, customer_id ASC

  SELECT
    AVG(annual_avg_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') AS sme_avg,
    AVG(annual_avg_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS lam_avg,
    AVG(annual_avg_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS kam_avg
  FROM least_customers
)
SELECT
  sme_avg - lam_avg AS diff_sme_minus_lam,
  lam_avg - kam_avg AS diff_lam_minus_kam,
